articles.author: Aidan  Stretch
articles.title: Fired Ukrainian defense minister says Ukraine is in a "technological war" with Russia - CBS News
articles.description: Mykhailo Fedorov, the former Ukrainian defense minister who is widely credited as the architect of the country's modern war-fighting strategy, told CBS News in an exclusive interview that he believes Ukraine is in a "technological war" with Russia.
